about: The mutant ledger of runtime/v1/net: edits of the leaf's source that its own tests must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./runtime/v1/net (docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger").

mutants.name: loopback-listen-unchecked
mutants.rule: A confined host refuses a non-loopback bind before opening anything.

mutants.name: loopback-dial-unchecked
mutants.rule: A confined host refuses a non-loopback dial before attempting to connect.

mutants.name: net-pipe-accept-lifo
mutants.rule: A pipe listener accepts in the order of the dials, as the host's backlog does.

mutants.name: net-pipe-close-unread-no-reset
mutants.rule: A pipe Close that leaves bytes unread resets the peer, whose next read fails, as TCP's does.

mutants.name: net-pipe-listener-close-keeps-address
mutants.rule: A closed pipe listener frees its address: a dial to it fails.

mutants.name: net-pipe-wait-ignores-stop
mutants.rule: A pipe Accept, Read or Write that waits ends on a stop of the caller.

mutants.name: net-host-read-not-armed
mutants.rule: A host Read that waits ends on a stop of the caller.

mutants.name: net-host-deadline-kept
mutants.rule: A host connection a stop ended a read of stays usable: the deadline the stop moved is cleared.

mutants.name: net1b-pipe-deadline-not-a-timeout
mutants.rule: A pipe connection's passed deadline fails its read as a timeout (os.ErrDeadlineExceeded), as net/http's abort of a background read expects.

mutants.name: net1b-pipe-past-deadline-ignored
mutants.rule: A deadline set in the past ends a pipe read that waits, which is how net/http ends its background read.

mutants.name: net-unix-confine-allows-abstract
mutants.rule: NetConfineUnix rejects abstract namespace (@) sockets and paths containing NUL bytes.

mutants.name: net-unix-pipe-recv-bound-ignored
mutants.rule: PipeNet RecvFDs enforces the caller maxFDs bound instead of returning more descriptors than requested.

mutants.name: net-unix-host-recv-ctrunc-ignored
mutants.rule: Host RecvFDs rejects truncated control messages (MSG_CTRUNC) or more descriptors than maxFDs.

mutants.name: net-unix-host-unlink-kept-on-into
mutants.rule: IntoUnixListener defaults to SetUnlinkOnClose(false) so closing an adopted listener keeps the path alive unless requested.

mutants.name: net-unix-pipe-listen-duplicate-allowed
mutants.rule: PipeNet.ListenUnix refuses binding a Unix socket path already in use.
